title: character spec
description: What a project.json `character` scene's `visual.spec` file points to. Consumed by scripts/render/character_scene.py -- a brief, static, on-brand stick-figure beat for the 'general overview, then zoom into detail' narrative transition. No rig, no gestures beyond the fixed named poses below.

pose.description: overview: open, presenting stance for a 'here's the whole system' beat. point-right: one arm extended, for the transition into a diagram placed to the right.

duration.description: Seconds the pose holds after its pop-in. Purely a manim-side pacing hint -- assemble_project.py still pads/truncates the rendered clip to whatever timing.py actually assigned the scene from narration.
